snippet.title: Tails & Trails - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Tails & Trails lets players explore cozy 3D worlds, follow winding trails, and solve playful puzzles. Along the way you photograph hidden cats, turning gentle exploration into a relaxing, collectible-driven adventure.
